context: Tests continuation links for multi-day work and the fixed Executive Summary placement.

checklist.name: Created a new dated entry
checklist.description: The agent creates a new entry dated 2026-04-10 instead of appending a paragraph to the 2026-04-09 entry.

checklist.name: Did not fold work into the old entry
checklist.description: The earlier entry's narrative is not extended with an Update (DD-MM-YYYY) paragraph.

checklist.name: continues_from set on the new entry
checklist.description: The new entry's frontmatter has `continues_from` pointing to the 2026-04-09 entry.

checklist.name: continued_by set on the old entry
checklist.description: The old entry's frontmatter gains `continued_by` pointing to the new entry, so the link is reciprocal.

checklist.name: Related Entries or Superseded banner
checklist.description: The linked entries carry the matching `## Related Entries` section or banner.

checklist.name: Executive Summary exists
checklist.description: The new entry has a `## Executive Summary` section.

checklist.name: Executive Summary directly after Session Overview
checklist.description: `## Executive Summary` is the H2 immediately following `## Session Overview`.

checklist.name: Executive Summary is short and complete
checklist.description: It covers problem, why it is non-trivial, options and the ask in a few lines.

checklist.name: Single H1 and triple date sync
checklist.description: The new entry has exactly one H1 and the date 2026-04-10 matches in filename, frontmatter and H1.

checklist.name: Validator run on both entries
checklist.description: The agent runs the validator and the reciprocal-link checks pass.
